name: Basement Pulse
description: A steady pulsing bass line whose filter slowly opens over the bars: warm, uneasy, 80s small-town dread.

name: Chrome Teeth
description: An aggressive, hard-clipped saw bass that snarls and pumps: dark synthwave at full throttle.

name: Classic Reese
description: The textbook Reese: one saw an octave down, seven detuned voices beating and phasing against each other, a clean sine sub underneath.

name: Cold Iron
description: A cold, piercing FM stab: an inharmonic clang on every hit over a clean sub, more struck metal than string.

name: Cyberpunk Industrial "Reese" Bass
description: Two wide detuned saw stacks beating against each other, a slow triangle and a decaying envelope sweeping a resonant ladder filter, hard-clipped and folded above 150 Hz, a touch of chorus, a clean sine sub under it all.

name: Destroyed Reese
description: Classic Reese pushed through all four GRIND stages, full drive, tape wow and OTT: the same seven-voice saw torn apart and wandering, the clean sine sub still underneath.

name: Distorted Hybrid Electric-Synth Bass
description: A plucked physical-model string with a pick transient through a high-gain tube amp and a dark cabinet, mids pushed and a little crush, while a clean sine sub carries everything under 120 Hz.

name: HS Bass Nine
description: After Howard Scarr's Diva classic: a fat, vintage Minimoog-style bass, two saws a hair apart over a round sub, the filter snapping open on every note and harder the harder you play.

name: HS Black Fuzz
description: After Howard Scarr's Diva preset: a dirty digital sync bass, a pulse torn by hard sync and slowly shifting, fuzzed and bright on top of a clean sub.

name: HS Bonebreaker
description: After Howard Scarr's Diva preset: two synced saws gliding legato, a tempo-locked saw LFO chewing the filter as the note builds, noise pulsing with it, phased and driven.

name: HS Boomer
description: After Howard Scarr's Diva preset: a clean, dark, phat sub with a quick thump into every note and a long glide, made to sit under everything.

name: HS Cable Bass
description: After Howard Scarr's Diva preset: a bright, aggressive poly pluck bass, a saw and a synced pulse snapping open, every note a little different, high notes damped.

name: Felt Floor
description: A soft, round bass with a felt-slow start: one dark saw under a low filter, warm and worn, never biting.

name: Fold Lung
description: A hollow, folded bass that breathes on its own: the folds open and close slowly, so the overtones keep turning over.

name: Glass Floor
description: A clean FM bass with a glassy edge that answers your touch: soft when played gently, a metallic knock when hit.

name: Granular & Sample-Mangled Organic Bass
description: Machinery static played two octaves down across the keys and scattered in pitch, a scanning metallic wavetable ring-modulated by FM, a band-pass sweeping 300 Hz to 2.5 kHz, tube drive, and a clean sine sub 6 dB under.

name: Grinder
description: An industrial feedback-FM grind with a tritone in its teeth: the hard, cold end of the shelf.

name: Hammer Stab
description: A short, hard, folded bass stab with a grain that ticks in time: cyberpunk in a single hit.

name: Iron Wobble
description: A LORN wobble bass: the filter and grit swing on the eighths, every swing a little different, over a sub two octaves down.

name: Kick Below
description: A short, deep thump: the pitch drops into the sub with a kick on top, felt more than heard.

name: Modular Feedback / Complex Shaper Bass
description: A hard-synced saw pair feeding back into its own FM until it turns chaotic, a resonant filter and a wavefolder each driven by its own wandering chaos source, brickwalled by the limiter.

name: Neon Octave
description: The driving octave bass of night-drive synthwave: every note a short, snappy bop, worn on tape.

name: Night Swell
description: A bass that swells into each note and opens slowly as it holds, like a tide coming in under the track.

name: Overdriven Acid / Industrial Saw Bass
description: A 303-style saw with a fifth of square under it, gliding legato into a diode ladder screaming near self-oscillation, a snappy envelope opening it on every note, accent on harder notes, then fuzz.

name: Rebar
description: A grinding industrial bass: FM and folding make it clank like metal under a diode filter.

name: Round Pulse
description: A hollow, steady square bass, clean and close: the bassline that sits under everything without asking for attention.

name: Rubber Night
description: A short, rubbery pluck bass: a resonant snap on every note, each one bouncing a little differently.

name: Rust Wobble
description: A detuned reese that wobbles on the quarter notes with the pump: the swing is in time, every swing a little worn and different.

name: Screaming FM / Neuro Bass
description: A sine carrier screamed up by two stacked FM operators (2:1 with heavy feedback, fed by 3.5:1), a resonant band-pass swept from 200 Hz to 4 kHz, a one-octave pitch drop on every hit, then 12-bit crush and hot tube drive.

name: Soft Sink
description: A soft, round sub-pluck that drops gently into each note and is gone: the quiet end of the shelf.

name: Square Shadow
description: A hollow, staccato square bass that slides between notes, its pulse width shifting in the dark.

name: Tape Sub
description: A warm sine sub warmed by tape until it's heard on small speakers too: soft, deep and steady.

name: Tear Line
description: A hard-sync bass that tears open on every note: a ripping, vocal sweep over a solid root and a clean sub.

name: The Drone / Sub-Rumble Bass
description: A metallic wavetable an octave down over a deep sine sub two octaves under, fading in over two seconds and out over three, darkened to 400 Hz, gently folded, its pitch drifting a few cents like old tape.

name: The Pulse / EBM Aggressive Bassline
description: A narrow square with a saw a fifth above it for industrial bite, a resonant low-pass snapping open on every note, short staccato shaping for 16ths, hard-clipped and pushed into tape.

name: Upright Ghost
description: A plucked upright bass in an empty club: a woody string, a round low note and a little room around it.

name: Velvet Thump
description: A short, soft thump of a bass: a round note that blooms and is gone, for basslines that bounce without biting.

name: Breather
description: A wide, sustained bass that inhales and exhales with the beat under heavy sidechain-style pumping.

name: Cavern
description: A dark bass drowned in a huge, dark room: the mids bloom open over seconds and sink into a long tail.

name: Crushed 808
description: A long, dark 808 through a wandering wavefolder, tape and a little crush: its grit never sits still as it rings out.

name: Dread
description: A heavy bass with a quiet tritone layer above it that beats and rubs: uneasy, like something is wrong.

name: Dust Ghost
description: A soft, half-there bass that blooms out of a cloud of dust and fades back into it, with a dark echo behind.

name: Metal Hull
description: A bass that groans like a ship hull: a comb resonance drifting slowly through the distortion.

name: Old Record
description: A round, warm bass lifted off a worn record: loud crackle and pops around it, narrow, dull and saturated.

name: Reverse Swell
description: Notes that swell in backwards and rush to a saturated peak, then hang in a dark echo.

name: Undertow
description: A deep, detuned bass dragged along by a dark rumble that surges and pulls back underneath it.

name: Terror Wall
description: A sustained wall of tube-saturated saws over a clean sub, crushed by compression and breathing with the beat.

name: Worn Tape
description: Bass from a tape that has been played to death: sick wow and flutter, crushed grain, hiss and a dull, warm top.

name: Acid Rain
description: An acid line through a screaming diode filter, accented, sliding and squelching in the rain.

name: Ascend Saw
description: A wall of detuned saws with an octave above, euphoric and huge, heard through a fog of tape and dust.

name: Black Sun
description: Stacked saws an octave apart, driven hard into a dark filter and a long smeared echo.

name: Broken Signal
description: A detuned saw lead on a sick tape, gliding between notes and repeating into a dark echo.

name: Chainsaw Lead
description: A raspy, buzzing mono lead: a hard-synced saw an octave up tearing through a narrow pulse stack, an envelope ripping its pitch on every note, fuzz and worn tape on top.

name: Dying Radio
description: A melody squeezed through a broken radio: band-limited, crushed and fading in and out of dust.

name: Ether Wave
description: A theremin: a pure sine sliding slowly through the air with a wide, trembling vibrato, straight out of an old sci-fi film.

name: Felt Lead
description: A soft, steady lead with no vibrato: a round triangle tone that sings quietly, close to the ear.

name: Ghost Whistle
description: A soft, breathy whistle with a slow vibrato, floating far away in the dark.

name: Glass Bell Lead
description: A glassy FM bell melody, bright at every strike and ringing into a cold room.

name: Glass Throat
description: A glassy FM lead whose edge thickens and thins as it sings.

name: Highway Glide
description: The night-drive portamento saw lead, gliding between notes over a triplet echo in a huge dark room.

name: Iron Lead
description: A hard, clipped saw lead that cuts straight through: no glide, no softness, all edge.

name: Kernel
description: A bouncing, plucky square lead, every note popping like a kernel in a pan, left to rot on tape.

name: Last Light
description: A soft FM lead with a long, slow glide, almost swallowed by reverb and air.

name: Lone Square
description: A simple, lonely square melody echoing in dotted time, like a game left running in an empty arcade.

name: Lucid Glide
description: A woozy psychedelic lead: detuned saws gliding slowly, wobbling and phasing, warm and wrong.

name: Mourning Horn
description: A lone horn-like lead that swells into each note with breath and a wide, sad vibrato.

name: Other Side
description: An eerie, detuned lead that glides and howls from somewhere it should not be, its tone slowly morphing.

name: Oxygen Drift
description: A thin, whistling lead swirling through a slow phaser, floating like oxygen in a dark sky.

name: Rain Flute
description: An airy synth flute: breath first, then a soft tone that brightens and sings with a late vibrato.

name: Rust Saw
description: A rough, folded saw that bites on every note and grinds as it sustains.

name: Scream Saw
description: A saw lead screaming through hard clipping, cutting through everything and only just under control.

name: Shine Solo
description: The classic seventies mono solo: fat saws through a singing filter, gliding between notes, worn and huge.

name: Siren Call
description: A hollow pulse lead that scoops up into each note, its width wandering like a voice.

name: Space Squiggle
description: A squiggling space-rock lead: a resonant filter twitching fast and the pitch drifting, like a signal from a seventies spaceship.

name: Stab Lead
description: Short, punchy lead stabs: a hollow pulse that speaks and stops, for riffs and call-and-response.

name: Staccato Cop
description: A punchy, bouncing staccato lead with a snappy filter: an eighties hook, dirtied and darkened.

name: Sunset Whine
description: A high, whining sine lead sliding between notes with a quick vibrato, warped like a tape from a lowrider at dusk.

name: Torn Signal
description: A hard-synced lead that tears open on every note, then settles into a phased, broken shimmer.

name: Velvet Pulse
description: A soft, hollow pulse lead whose width breathes slowly: warm, a little sad, very eighties.

name: Vice Night
description: An expressive, chorused eighties noir lead, bending and gliding with a deep vibrato over a rainy night city.

name: Warp Line
description: A lead on a badly warped tape: the pitch wanders and sags, nostalgic and slightly seasick.

name: Zap Line
description: A zapping laser lead: every note fires down in pitch before it settles, sci-fi and aggressive.

name: Bent Brass
description: A brass section that cannot hold its pitch: every note sags and drifts on worn tape.

name: Bite Horn
description: A horn that bites into every note and then sings: a hard, bright start over a held, dark tone.

name: Brass Fog
description: Soft brass that never quite comes into focus: slow swells drifting in a wide fog.

name: Doom Horns
description: A heavy horn section swelling open with every chord, saturated and huge in a dark space.

name: Falling Brass
description: A brass stab that sags as it dies, the pitch dropping like a tired sigh.

name: Ghost Section
description: Brass made mostly of breath: the players are there, but you can barely hear the notes.

name: Iron Stab
description: A hard, clipped brass hit: one bark, gone, leaving a dark ring behind.

name: Low Tubas
description: Deep tubas and cimbassi pushing air from below, with a low rumble under them.

name: Monolith
description: A colossal, hard-clipped brass braam an octave down, hanging in a vast concrete space.

name: Muted Horn
description: Soft, short horn notes, muted and round: brass that supports without pushing.

name: Rain Brass
description: A singing brass lead that brightens the longer you hold it, with a slow vibrato and a glide: lonely, in the rain.

name: Rooftop Stab
description: The big eighties poly brass stab: stacked saws punching open on every chord, short and proud, through worn tape.

name: Rotting Fanfare
description: A victory fanfare played back decades later on ruined equipment.

name: Rust Trumpets
description: Narrow, biting trumpets through crushed, rusty speakers.

name: Signal Horn
description: A single horn calling across a ruined landscape: it scoops up into each note and glides between them.

name: Thin Trumpet
description: One muted trumpet far down the street: thin, breathy and alone.

name: Tower Swell
description: Huge brass chords swelling up slowly and opening in a vast, smoky space over a burning city.

name: Velvet French
description: Warm, round French horns, soft at the edges and sad in the middle.

name: Warhorn
description: A colossal horn blast with an octave below and multiband grit: the call before the battle.

name: Ash Cloud
description: Wide detuned saws drifting under a slowly wandering filter, with fine dust settling over the chords.

name: Breathing Walls
description: A very wide wall of saws inhaling and exhaling with the beat, as if the room were alive.

name: Burnt Cloud
description: A pad pushed through a hard clipper until it burns: wide saws, scorched edges, crackle in the smoke.

name: Cathedral Rot
description: A decayed string-machine choir of PWM saws in a vast dark nave, blooming open over seconds.

name: Cold Breath
description: Soft triangles wrapped in breath and air: a frozen exhale that never quite settles.

name: Held Breath
description: A tense pad with a rub in the middle of it: two voices a semitone apart, waiting for something to happen.

name: Instant Fog
description: A pad that is there the moment you play: no swell, just warm chords appearing out of the fog.

name: Iron Fog
description: Chords through a drifting comb filter: metallic, hollow and groaning, over a low rumble.

name: Pulse Pad
description: A pad that pumps in quarter notes against the kick: chords that breathe on the beat.

name: Rift
description: Dark chords with a quiet tritone ghost beating against them: something is wrong in the harmony.

name: Rust Wall
description: A folded, metallic pad that breathes with the beat: a wall of rust that heaves in and out.

name: Seasick
description: A pad on a warped tape that won't stay in tune: every chord leans and slides, nauseous and beautiful.

name: Static Heaven
description: A shimmering wavetable pad seen through broken digital glass: crushed grain over a wandering timbre.

name: Sunken
description: Starts buried and muffled, then slowly rises toward the surface as you hold it, over a deep hum.

name: Tape Ghosts
description: Chords played back from a stretched, dying tape: seasick wow, dull top and crackle.

name: Tidal Fog
description: A pad whose filter rises and falls in time over two bars, like a slow tide under the drifting fog.

name: Velvet Neon
description: The classic PWM pad under a lush stereo chorus, swelling in soft and wide, now worn on tape and lost in the dark.

name: Velvet Smoke
description: Soft FM sines that thicken and thin as the modulation drifts, smoky and warm.

name: Warm Dread
description: A thick two-oscillator analog pad that swells and slowly opens, dreamy on top and uneasy underneath.

name: Black Ensemble
description: A dark string section of saws and PWM through a wide ensemble, bowing slowly into a worn hall.

name: Distant Hall
description: Strings heard from the far end of a vast empty hall, mostly echo and air.

name: Frost Violins
description: High violins, cold and thin, shivering in the air above everything else.

name: Funeral Section
description: Heavy, slow bows that take their time to arrive and linger in a long dark room.

name: Glass Strings
description: Strings with a glassy FM edge, as if bowed on frozen wire.

name: Grind Cellos
description: Low cellos dug in hard: the bow grinds, the tone saturates, menace in the low strings.

name: Hammer Section
description: A whole string section hitting one chord and letting go: a hard, short stab with a dark tail.

name: Lone Violin
description: One violin alone in a cold hall: thin, close and singing with a slow vibrato.

name: Machine Strings
description: The seventies string machine: thin bright saws made lush by an ensemble chorus and a slow phaser, gone soft with age.

name: Rotten Orchestra
description: An orchestra rotting on old tape: seasick pitch, crushed grain and crackle.

name: Saw Ostinato
description: Driven, short string bows chugging an ostinato: dark, gritty and relentless.

name: Solina Ghost
description: The ghost of a 70s string machine: PWM through a lush ensemble, tape-warped and dusty.

name: Staccato Rain
description: Short, hollow pulse-wave strings, bowed tight and quick, their tone rising and falling over two bars.

name: Sul Ponticello
description: Bowed close to the bridge: hollowed out in the middle, thin, airy and scratchy.

name: Tremolo Dread
description: Nervous tremolo bowing that never settles into a pattern: tension under a horror scene.

name: Tremor Bows
description: Strings trembling hard and fast, bows shaking on the edge: tension for the moment before the drop.

name: Worn Cellos
description: Low cellos on a stretched tape: rough bows, a slow singing vibrato and crackle around them.

name: Backwards Room
description: Keys played backwards: each note swells in out of nothing, opens up and is cut off, leaving only the room.

name: Bell Piano
description: The eighties layered piano: a soft FM piano with a glassy bell ringing above it, faded on old tape.

name: Breath Keys
description: Soft triangle keys with a little air in every note, like a sigh between chords.

name: Burnt Rhodes
description: A worn electric piano: soft tines that bark when hit hard, wobbling on old tape.

name: Clav Ghost
description: A short, snappy clavinet played through broken digital speakers.

name: Cotton Tines
description: A soft electric piano played at a whisper: round tines with no bark, warm and close.

name: Dream Organ
description: A soft combo organ, warm and chorused, floating in a vast room: dream pop at three in the morning.

name: Dust Organ
description: An old drawbar organ with a key click, slowly spinning speaker and dust in its pipes.

name: Felt Piano
description: A muted upright with felt on the hammers: soft, intimate and slightly out of tune.

name: Glass Decade
description: Late-eighties digital keys: a glassy bell strikes on top while a soft pad body sustains underneath, chorused and faded.

name: Glass Harp
description: Bright, glassy FM keys like wet fingers on crystal, ringing into a cold room.

name: Glass Tine
description: The eighties FM electric piano: a glassy tine over a soft round body, chorused and phased, now on a worn tape in a dark room.

name: Harbour Reed
description: A bandoneon by a cold harbour: two reeds beating against each other, the bellows swelling under a slow, melancholic chord.

name: Hush Vibes
description: A soft vibraphone with a slow tremolo, hit with yarn mallets in a dim room.

name: Lo-Fi Grand
description: A grand piano sampled from a cassette: soft, wide, warbling and dull.

name: Midnight Upright
description: A plucked-string piano in an empty bar after closing: woody, ringing and a little sour.

name: Moth Keys
description: Soft FM keys that flutter into each note and hang in the air like dust in lamplight.

name: Night Stab
description: Short, punchy saw chord stabs that snap open and vanish into a dark echo.

name: Pedal Wash
description: A soft piano with the sustain pedal held down forever: every note rings on into a warm, blurred wash.

name: Pump Breath
description: A pump organ in a cold chapel: reedy, wheezing, the bellows breathing under every chord.

name: Quiet Reed
description: A reedy electric piano turned all the way down: soft, round, with a lazy tremolo.

name: Reed Tears
description: A melodica played in an empty stairwell: breathy, reedy, wobbling and sad.

name: Saloon Rot
description: A honky-tonk upright with every string pair out of tune, beating and jangling in an empty saloon.

name: Shiver Keys
description: Hollow pulse keys with a fast, shivering tremolo and a soft overdrive, like an old organ in a cold church.

name: Sleep Organ
description: A soft sine organ, two drawbars and nothing else, breathing slowly in the dark.

name: Small Hours
description: A celesta in the small hours: tiny, sweet, glassy bells, a little out of reach.

name: Stage Phase
description: A stage electric piano swirling through a phaser, seventies-soft and slightly seasick.

name: Tin Clock
description: Wavetable keys through a low-pass gate, their tone ticking along in time like a tin clock in an empty house.

name: Toy Box
description: A child's toy piano left in an attic for decades: thin, bell-like, warped and crackling.

name: Vox Dust
description: A sixties transistor combo organ, bright and buzzy with its own wobbling vibrato, coated in dust.

name: Wurly Rot
description: A reedy, overdriven electric piano with a wandering tremolo, rotting in a damp room.

name: Breathing Arp
description: A soft arpeggio with air in every note, rising and falling like slow breathing.

name: Chapter One
description: A warm analog arpeggio whose filter opens slowly over the bars, glowing and ominous: an eighties mystery beginning.

name: Clean Glass Sequence
description: A clean, glassy sequence: pure FM notes with no grit, just tape age and air around them.

name: Cold Monday
description: A cold, stuttering square sequence chopping in sixteenths, mechanical and lonely.

name: Cradle Arp
description: A slow, soft sine-bell arpeggio rocking back and forth like a cradle.

name: Dream Children
description: A dreamy, piano-like arpeggio echoing into a huge space: nineties euphoria remembered through fog.

name: Fever
description: A hot, compressed PWM-saw sequence pushing hard against the multiband compressor.

name: Field Organ
description: A hypnotic organ pattern repeating over a field at dusk, trembling with a fast tremolo.

name: Glass Lullaby
description: A glassy music-box arpeggio, small and sweet, ringing in a big quiet room.

name: Gridlock
description: A tempo-locked synthwave arpeggio: a resonant diode filter sweeping in time, pumping on the eighths, echoing into the dark.

name: Love Machine
description: A driving low sequence, octaves pulsing in sixteenths with a snappy filter: the machine that started it all, rusted.

name: Machinery
description: A metallic comb sequence like gears and pistons in a dark factory.

name: Night Drive
description: Octave-stacked saws racing through a wide chorus and a heavy pump: headlights in the rain.

name: Pulse Engine
description: A driving saw sequence pumping against the beat as its filter slowly opens and closes.

name: Random Bleeps
description: Random stepped bleeps: a resonant filter jumping on every sixteenth, like an old computer thinking aloud.

name: Slow Tide
description: A soft saw arpeggio whose filter rises and falls over the bars like a slow tide.

name: Squelch Line
description: A squelching acid sequence: every accent bites through a screaming diode filter.

name: Static Ladder
description: A dark, squelching diode-filter sequence, its accents biting through the haze.

name: Triplet Machine
description: A hard-clipped arp through a low-pass gate, a twitch on every note, falling into triplet echoes.

name: Blackwater
description: A deep, dark pluck that barely opens before it sinks into a murky room.

name: Bone
description: A hollow, woody FM knock, like tapping on bone in a dark room.

name: Dead Strings
description: A palm-muted guitar string: tight, woody and dead short, picked in an empty room.

name: Dub Echo
description: A short pluck thrown into a tape echo turned up until it swirls, smears and nearly runs away.

name: Hollow Euphoria
description: A huge stack of detuned saws plucked short and thrown into a big echo: euphoria, seen through dirty glass.

name: Neon Snap
description: The classic eighties analog pluck: a warm saw snapping open and shut, chorused, now worn and dusty.

name: Palm Glass
description: A soft, round marimba pluck with a little glassy shimmer, warm wood under a cold night sky.

name: Paper Pluck
description: A muted, papery string pluck: barely there, dry and gentle.

name: Pizz Dust
description: A string section playing pizzicato: short, dry plucks of many strings at once, crackling with dust.

name: Ringing Wire
description: A plucked wire that rings on and on, the note hanging in the dark long after the pick.

name: Rust Pluck
description: A biting saw pluck, folded and crushed: every note a little different shard of metal.

name: Soft Harp
description: A gentle harp, plucked softly and left to float in a big, quiet room.

name: Thick Pluck
description: A big, thick pluck: five detuned saws and an octave below, filling the whole middle of the track.

name: Velvet Pick
description: A soft triangle pluck with an octave shadow and a slow chorus, velvet-smooth.

name: Wet Neon
description: A short neon pluck whose dotted-eighth echo becomes the rhythm, softly overdriven and dissolving in a huge room.

name: Wood Hush
description: A soft wooden mallet on a marimba bar: a warm knock that fades fast.

name: Air Fall
description: Air played across the keys, gliding slowly and braking over four bars.

name: Air Pulse
description: Breathy air in four soft plucks per bar, widened by the ensemble.

name: Breath Duck
description: Air ducking on every beat, a breathing sidechain of pure breath.

name: Crackle Kit
description: Crackle hits across the keys: low notes thump, high notes tick, ducked into the beat.

name: Crackle Ratchet
description: Vinyl crackle that plucks once, twice, then rolls into four.

name: Dust Swing
description: Dust and ticks in a lazy long-short swing, like a loop off an old sampler.

name: Dust Triplets
description: A dust hit on each note, gated into triplets and smeared with a little wow.

name: Hiss Brake
description: Hiss pulsing slower and slower as if the reel is running down.

name: Random Grain
description: Crackle gated and filtered by new random steps every cycle: never the same bar twice.

name: Rumble Wub
description: Low rumble through a resonant low-pass, wubbing in quarters.

name: Slow Tide
description: Rumble an octave and more down, rising and falling over four bars like a tide.

name: Snare Swing
description: White noise hits across the keys in a swung sixteenth gate, tuned like a noise snare.

name: Stair Dust
description: Dust stepping its filter down a staircase over two bars.

name: Static Line
description: Static played across the keys an octave down, its filter sweeping shut every eighth.

name: Static Roll
description: A burst of static hit on every note, rolled into a ratchet.

name: Static Triplets
description: Grainy static fizz gated in even triplets across the bar.

name: Sunk Hiss
description: Hiss slowed four octaves into a dark roar, swelling up each bar and snapping shut.

name: Sync Static
description: Fuzzed static on a 3-3-2 gate, the push of a broken drum machine.

name: Tape Gate
description: Worn tape hiss chopped into tight sixteenths, the gaps breathing with the wow.

name: Tape Stop Lead
description: Hiss played across the keys, gliding between notes like a reel speeding up and stopping.

name: White Sweep
description: Plain white noise swept shut every eighth, a clean riser-snare grain.

name: Yoyo Hiss
description: Hiss opening in two humps per bar, small then big.

name: Brutish
description: Port of Arturia Jup-8 V's Brutish: a slow Jupiter pad, a pulse an octave down and a saw, the resonant filter swelling open over seconds, gently vibrating, through the Juno / Jupiter chorus. Missing: the cross-mod.

name: BT crushed sines
description: Port of BigTone's Diva BT crushed sines: an ambient sine with a zapping attack, crushed and dark, harder notes zapping further. Missing: Diva's self-oscillating filter (the sine is an oscillator here) and its reverb and delay.

name: Down Not Out
description: Port of Arturia Jup-8 V's Down Not Out: a long, evolving Jupiter bass, a pulse an octave down under a saw, the filter opening slowly as the note holds and drifting with a slow LFO. Missing: the Jupiter's cross-mod.

name: From The Deep
description: Port of Arturia SEM V's From The Deep: an atmospheric, deep pulse bass through the SEM filter, overdriven, playing harder opens and drives it.

name: Razor Hoover
description: Port of Arturia Mini V's Razor Hoover: three saws stacked in unison and detuned into a hoover, with noise, through an almost open ladder filter. The Mini's third oscillator, two octaves down, is the sub here.

name: Rita
description: Port of Arturia SEM V's Rita: a two-saw mono lead an octave up through a resonant SEM filter, softly swelling in; the mod wheel brings in the vibrato.

name: SG MS-101
description: Port of Sjoerd van Geffen's Diva SG MS-101: a dark, aggressive mono bass, a saw and a fifth-up PWM saw through a resonant filter swept hard by a velocity-fed envelope. Missing: Diva's resonant high-pass before the filter.

name: TH Rough Rider
description: Port of Thomas Helzle's Diva TH Rough Rider: a dirty, aggressive plucked mono bass, a saw and a fifth-up PWM saw, fed back hard into a bright filter that the mod wheel closes. Missing: the moving resonant high-pass.

name: Velo SEM
description: Port of Arturia SEM V's Velo SEM: two unison saws through a resonant, key-tracked SEM filter that plucks with every note, the velocity setting how far.

name: XS Modwheel Reese
description: Port of Xenos Soundworks' Diva XS Modwheel Reese: the standard drum & bass Reese, three saws spread ±35 cents with noise through a resonant filter; the mod wheel opens it. Missing: Diva's Bite filter.

name: Diode Acid
description: Squelching 303 line through an 18 dB diode filter: accents bite harder, overlapping notes slide.

name: Log Drum
description: Amapiano log drum: a hollow, woody FM thud with a pitch bend and a deep rubbery sub that slides.

name: Baile Knock
description: Raw baile-funk sub pluck: a sharp downbeat thump with a lo-fi, crunchy mid-range knock on top.

name: Auto-Wah Funk
description: Bootsy-style envelope-filter funk: a resonant filter that quacks open with every note, wider the harder you play.

name: Brass Braam
description: Colossal cinematic braam: a wall of detuned saws swelling open like a low brass section, saturated and huge.

name: West Coast Bongo
description: West Coast bass: a wavefolded triangle through a low-pass gate, woody and acoustic, brighter the harder you play.

name: 8-Bit Pulse
description: Deliberately lo-fi chiptune bass: a 25% NES pulse and triangle, bit-crushed, with a duty-cycle wobble.

name: Tick-Tock Pluck
description: Cinematic tension pluck: a tight bass pluck with a ticking transient and clockwork echoes.

name: Gear Grinder
description: Mid-tempo cyberpunk bass: a crushing square through a sweeping notch filter, like grinding machine gears.

name: Cold Wave
description: Cold, rigid post-punk bass: hollow pulse and saw, hard compression, heavy chorus and a dark room.

name: Pipe Donk
description: Hard-dance donk: a pitch-bent, metallic FM clack like a struck plastic pipe, with a short body.

name: Apocalypse Horn
description: Sci-fi drone horn: massive detuned saws and pulse opening very slowly into an apocalyptic brass roar.

name: Sound System Dub
description: King Tubby-style dub bass: all highs filtered away, leaving a warm, heavy sound-system thud.

name: Glass Slap
description: Hyper-percussive DX7 slap: a glassy, high-ratio FM snap that drops away into a short, round thump.

name: Machine EBM
description: Driving EBM bass: overdriven saw and square with a hard filter snap and a mechanical 16th-note pulse.

name: Lately Plunk
description: Solid four-operator FM bass: a metallic plunk on every note that settles into a round, punchy body.

name: Snap FM
description: Bright metallic FM pluck: a high-index snap with feedback grit and a touch of flanged shimmer.

name: Modular Drift
description: Generative modular drone: two wavetables and FM cross-modulated by random sample-and-hold and drifting sources.

name: G-Funk Whine
description: West Coast G-funk bass: a deep, smooth triangle sub under a singing, gliding high sine whine.

name: Micro Glitch
description: Glitch micro-bass: stuttering 1/32 gates, random filter and bitcrush bursts over a steady sub.

name: Reverse Kick
description: Hardstyle reverse bass: a distorted, tuned kick hit followed by a backwards-swelling, rising sub that cuts dead.

name: Juno Hoover
description: Rave hoover: swirling PWM saws gliding through a lush three-voice ensemble chorus.

name: Chunky Square
description: Clean, mid-heavy, slightly overdriven square bass with clockwork precision, like a picked indie bass.

name: Infra Rumble
description: LORN-style ghost sub: a sine at the threshold of hearing, made audible by saturation, slowly breathing.

name: Broken Tape
description: LORN-style decayed bass: saturated and worn, with unstable random pitch flutter, dark echoes and a haunted room.

name: M1 Plastic
description: 90s Eurodance bass: a bright plastic click on top of a hollow, rubbery square-and-sine body.

name: Ladder Moog
description: Fat saw-plus-square ladder bass with a punchy filter envelope, warm drive and tape glue.

name: Munich Octave
description: Tight, clicky sequencer bass made for octave-jumping disco lines, with a short filter snap and echo.

name: Neuro Machine
description: Hyper-complex neuro bass: a pitch-tracked comb filter, random wavetable jumps, phasing and multiband dirt.

name: Toxic Fuzz
description: Industrial-rock fuzz bass: raw clipping, fuzz and white noise built to tear through a wall of guitars.

name: Rubber Disco
description: Elastic nu-disco bass: a resonant filter envelope gives every note a vocal "oww-waw" bounce.

name: Filtered Drawbar
description: Overdriven drawbar organ bass filtered down to its warm lows, with key click and a gentle rotary shimmer.

name: Bowed Hybrid
description: Organic hybrid bass: a dark physical-model string layered on a pure sine sub, with gentle chorus and space.

name: Drift Phonk
description: Blown-out drift-phonk bass: low, detuned squares smashed into clipping, gliding hard between notes.

name: Plucked Tube
description: Physical-model bass: a modelled plucked string over a sine body, eerily real with a faint flanged air.

name: Breakdown Drop
description: Pop-punk sub drop: one clean sine sweeping dramatically down two octaves into the breakdown.

name: Psy Rolling
description: Short, hyper-compressed psytrance saw pluck shaped to bounce tightly between the kicks.

name: Pure Sine Sub
description: Clean, unmodulated sine sub living below 60 Hz: pure weight, felt rather than heard.

name: Rage Fuzz 808
description: Rage/hyperpop 808 pushed far past clipping into square-wave fuzz, with a tuned kick punch on top.

name: Phase Reese
description: Detuned saw stack beating against an octave-down saw: dark, wide and slowly churning over a clean sub.

name: Dembow Sub
description: Round, heavily compressed reggaeton sub with warm tape saturation for weight under the dembow.

name: Silk Pluck
description: Minimal 2000s R&B pluck: a clean triangle-and-sine tick that decays fast and leaves the mix wide open.

name: Floor Fog
description: Shoegaze wall of low fog: a seven-voice saw cloud soaked in ensemble chorus, long reverb and echoes.

name: Classic 808
description: Long, saturated sine 808 with a tuned kick punch, a pitch drop and slides between overlapping notes.

name: Drop-G Doom
description: Ultra-low synth-metal bass: fuzzed saw and square like a five-string tuned to drop G, scooped and huge.

name: Outrun Drive
description: Snappy, tightly compressed Juno/Prophet saw bass with a short filter blip and chorus shine.

name: Taurus Pedal
description: Room-shaking pedal-synth bass: low saw and square, huge sustain and a deep, slow-closing filter.

name: Brostep Wobble
description: Tempo-synced 1/8 filter wobble on stacked saws and a soft square, with tube grit and a solid sub.
